create_benchmark_server: create an async gRPC benchmark server from a ServerConfig with optional SSL credentials
create_benchmark_client: create an async benchmark client for unary or streaming RPC types from a ClientConfig
run_server_benchmark: run a benchmark server that spawns sub workers across multiple processes and reports status
run_client_benchmark: run a benchmark client that spawns sub workers across multiple processes and merges latency stats
get_server_status: get a ServerStatus proto message with elapsed time stats for a given port
